author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Episode 3 of Dragon Ball Super: Beerus, featuring Vegeta vs Beerus is going to be a controversial episodes I assure you. While it does largely deliver on the series' mission statement of upgrading the visuals, it did so this time at the expense of a substantial amount of characterisation for Vegeta. But, depending on the type of Dragon Ball fan you are, this will either be received as good news or bad.

title: This Episode is Gonna Make People MAD!
